limits.projection_format: One ordinary unindented import per line; exact named namespace closure and a unique -- BEGIN PROOFS boundary. Not a general Lean parser. Late ordinary runtime declarations block.
limits.source_binding: Captured Lean/config bytes must equal recorded HEAD Git objects. Spec and runner are byte-bound and checked for drift; final production freeze must independently bind their Git objects.
limits.trust: Installed external Lean/mathlib dependencies are identified by tool executable hash and project toolchain/lockfile; their package trees are not byte-inventoried. Source/spec execution is trusted; controls do not claim resistance to arbitrary checker tampering.
limits.evidence: Synthetic committed fixture repositories, real CLI and Lean computations only. Not production mutation or theorem evidence.
